component.name: Desktop College Dorms
component.summary: Offline AI character creator and chat rooms

description.p: Create AI characters with images, GIFs, video or VRM/VRoid 3D models, import character cards in the common V1/V2/V3 format (PNG or JSON), and chat one-on-one, in groups, or in Discord-style channels where characters talk to each other.

Everything is stored on your computer. A local model engine (llama.cpp) is built in, so there is nothing else to install. Cloud providers such as OpenAI-compatible servers and Anthropic are optional and use your own API key over an encrypted connection.

ul.li: Chub-style character editor with token counts, alternate greetings and embedded lorebooks
Lenient card import that keeps unknown fields so round trips lose nothing
Group chats and channels with optional bot-to-bot conversation
Built-in local models with a hardware-aware downloader, GPU acceleration through Vulkan
